name: token-vault
description: Use named credentials through one-use links or encrypted offline envelopes without placing plaintext tokens in MCP messages.

interface.shortDescription: 私有凭据与一次性领取
interface.longDescription: Connect your own Token Vault. Use the original one-use CLI links or optional offline encrypted envelopes with the packaged Node helper. Requires a connected vault, an authorized task and a terminal-capable agent.
interface.defaultPrompt: 使用 Token Vault 列出凭据，为我授权的 CLI 任务申请一次性链接；不要把长期 Token 放进对话或工具参数。
